question: The Uttar Pradesh cabinet approved a proposal to name a zoological garden at ________ after the freedom fighter and revolutionary Ashfaqullah Khan.
solution:
The correct answer is __Gorakhpur__.

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Recently, the Uttar Pradesh Cabinet approved a proposal to set up a zoological garden in Gorakhpur on 121 acres.
 
• A plan to set aside Rs 234 crore for the development of a zoological garden named after Shaheed Ashfaqullah Khan was approved by the Uttar Pradesh state government on 8 January 2020.
 
• It aims to attract tourists and to increase employment opportunities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Ashfaqulla Khan was a freedom fighter in the Indian independence movement.
 
• He was born on 22 October 1900 in Shahjahanpur, Uttar Pradesh.
 
• He participated in Gandhi's non-cooperation movement (NCM), Chauri Chaura incident.
 
• Ashfaqulla Khan formed the Hindustan Republican Association (HRA) along with Ram Prasad Bismil.
 
• At present, there are two zoological gardens in Uttar Pradesh namely:
 
 
• Nawab Wajid Ali Shah Zoological Garden in Lucknow
 
• Kanpur Zoological Park in Kanpur
